WITH item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS DATE)
),
returns_agg AS (
    SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS ret_count,
           SUM(COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0)) AS ret_refund
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_order_number, cr_item_sk
)
SELECT
    w.w_state,
    i.i_item_id,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(d.d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE) THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN r.ret_count IS NULL THEN cs.cs_sales_price
                    ELSE cs.cs_sales_price * r.ret_count - r.ret_refund
                END
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS sales_before,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(d.d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE) THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN r.ret_count IS NULL THEN cs.cs_sales_price
                    ELSE cs.cs_sales_price * r.ret_count - r.ret_refund
                END
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS sales_after
FROM warehouse w
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item_filtered i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim_filtered d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON cs.cs_order_number = r.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = r.cr_item_sk
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
